rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a very poor-quality early blastocyst/compacting embryo and absent-poor ICM/TE, but it overstates certainty and includes some features not clearly discernible from the image alone (e.g., necrotic inclusions, disrupted junctions, precise vacuolation details).

Integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve markers, prior cycle history, sperm parameters, diagnosis, and endometrium well with embryo prognosis, though some links (e.g., assigning embryo quality mainly to obesity/oocyte competence) are somewhat speculative.

The reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with the low implantation estimate appropriately driven by the DD morphology; minor issues include overinterpretation of Day 4 timing and recurrent implantation failure from the limited history.

Much of the counseling is broadly evidence-based, but several recommendations are not strongly guideline-supported or are controversial/routine-overused in IVF practice (ERA, NK-cell testing, broad thrombophilia workup, strong endorsement of PGT-A and supplements in this exact scenario).

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer counseling and future optimization, protocol reconsideration, and uterine evaluation, though some suggested investigations/interventions may be more extensive than necessary.
